threads.body:
@copilot Update this PR directly to fix both SDK 1.68.0 CI incompatibilities discussed below. Keep the SDK upgrade to 1.68.0 and preserve this PR's draft/ready state. Do not create another PR.

Update the Java contrib dependencies to the just-released 1.62.1 release, using the appropriate published alpha coordinates for the existing dependency set in dependencyManagement/build.gradle.kts. The AWS X-Ray propagator currently calls io.opentelemetry.api.internal.StringUtils.padLeft(String, int), which SDK 1.68.0 removed. Contrib 1.62.1 includes open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-contrib#3208 and removes that internal dependency. This causes NoSuchMethodError failures in AWS SDK SQS, Lambda, and Camel tests, missing Lambda spans and trace-wait timeouts, and the X-Ray propagation smoke failure. Update directly related generated license information as needed.

Fix instrumentation/resources/library/src/test/java/io/opentelemetry/instrumentation/resources/internal/ResourceDeclarativeConfigTest.java. Its endToEnd test at line 53 introspects sharedState.resource, but SDK 1.68.0 replaced that field with resourceProvider. Prefer verifying the configured resource through an exported span using existing test helpers rather than reflecting into SDK internals. Preserve all existing resource attribute, entity, and schema assertions and the declarative configuration coverage.

Follow the repository instructions, run the narrowest applicable formatting and relevant tests for both fixes, and keep changes limited to these two compatibility issues. Acceptance criteria: the fixed contrib artifact is selected, X-Ray extraction no longer links to the removed method, and the resource test verifies the same configured resource without relying on the removed SDK field.
